description: Turn a paused automation back on, on every account it runs on. It starts replying to real people again. A draft has to be finished in sprkly first. An automation that hit its "stop after this many people" limit stays off. One that ended (ended is true in sprkly_list_automations) stays off unless you pass ends_at: a new end time, or an empty string for no end.

ends_at.description: Optional. A new time for it to switch itself off, as an ISO 8601 time in the future with a time zone. An empty string removes the end. Leave it out to keep the end it has.

name: sprkly_resume_automation
title: Resume an automation
